metric_definitions.training_catalog_recovery: At most 50 seed-42 selected training users, ordered lexicographically before sampling. The final training event is recovered from strictly earlier events, retaining at most L-1 events and appending MASK at absolute index L-1. Full-history and retained-window filtering both restore the target exactly once. Catalog ranks use descending FP32 ModelView scores and ascending mapped IDs for exact ties, under fixed 4096-item chunks with an unmodified final remainder. Two passes extract and verify the target score and count preceding eligible competitors. N excludes the target, K=rank-1, m=min(99,N). Expected sampled HR10 is Hypergeometric(N,K,m).cdf(9), with N=0 defined as one. This assumes uniform distinct negatives under the reported eligibility, not necessarily the host policy. Sampled-minus-catalog and sampled-hit/catalog-miss are paired user quantities. Each summary uses 1000 seed-42 user bootstrap replicates; intervals condition on selected users, fitted weights and policies. Optional draws 42/43/44 reuse catalog-pass scores and are reported separately per user. Repeated targets and strict-unseen exclusions are explicit. Partial cohorts, failures, effective precision, actual counts and synchronized diagnostic cost are reported. Partial cohorts have available=false; any retained summaries describe completed users only. Calibration summaries retain seeds separately and report three-draw rank ranges and hit flips. Bounded live cross-chunk fixtures compare scores, exact ranks and ordered top10; near-tie rank changes remain visible even when scores pass tolerance. Universal cross-shape invariance and fresh-process predictor parity remain unmeasured here. This is training recovery, not held-out quality, user preference, or a selection metric.
metric_definitions.consumed_pipeline_audit: At most four explicitly supplied production records. Independently reconstructs crops, source events, reserved-mask corruption, labels and seeded negative draws from public training histories. Same-forward detached logits check pooled CE/BPR scalar reduction without a second forward; tolerances are recorded per dtype. No gradient certification. Calibration uses only the first retained record, verified changed-label and restored-mask faults, plus clean and consistent row-permutation controls. Coverage is detected divided by verified non-equivalent corruptions; zero denominators are null. Repeated-ID shifts are equivalent for the label-only operator. These bounded controls do not estimate real fault prevalence. Captures need not belong to the selected checkpoint. Missing transport, deployment parity and held-out gains remain unavailable. No production iterator is advanced when captured replay is supplied; worker state and exact restart are not certified.
metric_definitions.bert4rec_integrity: Independent appended-mask fixtures compare exact IDs and live candidate scores at rtol=1.3e-6, atol=1e-5. Includes padding perturbation and negative controls. False checks require investigation; unavailable checks are not passes. Synthetic provenance controls do not certify the actual sampler.
metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: (Mean off-diagonal pairwise cosine + 1)/2 over up to 2048 seed-42 sampled catalog embeddings, excluding padding and mask. Measures angular alignment, not recommendation diversity or representation quality by itself.
metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_reason: Reason the collapse statistic is undefined, or null
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Training-exposed mean positive-minus-negative logit at valid masked targets
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Training-exposed nearest-rank tenth percentile of masked-target margins
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid masked targets with margin < 0
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid masked targets with margin < 0.5
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_sample_count: Number of valid supervised reserved-mask positions observed
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_reason: Reason no valid training margins were observed, or null
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Observed batch, invalid-target and low-margin counts. Category lists remain empty because item category metadata is unavailable. The supplied sampler always masks selected targets.
metric_definitions.training_history_sensitivity: Unavailable in this workflow: no history interventions were executed. The following describes the retained legacy probe only, not measured results: One last training target/user with strictly earlier prefix truncated to L-1; earlier repeats are retained. Up to 200 users selected with seed 42. Candidate draws 42/43/44 are reported separately. Rank is one-based with stable candidate-order ties; HR10 is rank<=10; margin is target minus hardest negative. Each delta is intervention minus original. Recent-minus-older is newest-block intervention minus oldest-block intervention; k=min(3,floor(n/2)). Overlap is intersection/minimum returned top-list length. Compact deletion shifts survivor positions; mask replacement retains positions and introduces learned mask content. Attention deletion is unavailable without a supported hook. Means have 1000-resample seed-42 user-bootstrap percentile 95% intervals, conditional on the selected users and candidate draw. These intervals exclude checkpoint-selection uncertainty. Popularity quartiles use catalog training counts; length quartiles use selected retained prefix lengths; tied cutpoints may produce empty strata. Results describe training-exposed sensitivity, not causal preferences, memorization alone or held-out generalization. Host validation is unchanged; no four-category macro is fabricated.
